page_title: PAR 1-1 AUX | Paris FC v Auxerre 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Francois Letexier is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Lohann Doucet (Paris FC) sends a long ball in, but Donovan Leon comfortably gathers the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) commits a rough challenge and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul.
90' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
89' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Paris FC comes to nothing.
87' Paris FC take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
85' Christophe Pelissier has decided to substitute Oussama El Azzouzi and he is replaced by Assane Diousse (Auxerre).
85' Substitution. Josue Casimir (Auxerre) has come on for Lassine Sinayoko.
84' Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) is about to take a corner kick.
82' A poor finish by Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
82' Lohann Doucet (Paris FC) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
81' Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) is penalised.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Tuomas Ollila (Paris FC) coming on for Thibault De Smet.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) is replacing Jean-Philippe Krasso.
79' Stephane Gilli has decided to make a change. Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) replaces Adama Camara.
76' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.
76' Auxerre are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
73' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) trips an opposition player and Francois Letexier signals a foul.
71' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) replacing Sekou Mara.
70' Substitution. Moses Simon walks off the pitch and Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) comes on as a substitute.
70' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
67' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
66' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Sekou Mara (Auxerre) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Francois Letexier blows his whistle after Hamari Traore (Paris FC) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
62' Francois Letexier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kevin Danois (Auxerre).
61' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alimani Gory as he is replaced by Lohann Doucet (Paris FC).
59' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) is punished with the yellow card.
59' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

58' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Francois Letexier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a free kick to Paris FC, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
56' A quickly taken corner by Paris FC.
56' Moses Simon (Paris FC) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Paris FC.
54' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Paris FC.
51' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

49' Golden chance! Adama Camara (Paris FC) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.

48' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Paris FC will have a goal kick.
47' Francois Letexier blows the whistle, Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) is penalised for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Francois Letexier has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Auxerre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45+3' That didn't go as planned! Sekou Mara (Auxerre) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the roof of the net was too weak to get past Obed Nkambadio, who easily kept it out. The ball goes out of play. Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
45+2' Moses Simon (Paris FC) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Paris FC seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Lassine Sinayoko picks out Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the middle of the goal with a header from close range. 1:1.
39' Otavio (Paris FC) picks up a yellow card.
39' Otavio (Paris FC) jumps into a tackle and Francois Letexier signals a foul. That's a free kick to Auxerre.

39' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
38' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Moses Simon (Paris FC), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
35' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Paris FC.
32' 1 - 0 Goal! Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Donovan Leon.
32' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) is going to take the penalty!
31' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
30' There's a break in play and referee Francois Letexier must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Paris FC using VAR. This could be interesting!
29' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
28' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) tries to find Rudy Matondo, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Paris FC are taking a throw-in.
27' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) has time in the box after a cross from Moses Simon, but places his shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
26' The Paris FC players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

23' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
21' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Donovan Leon intercepts the ball.
19' Auxerre enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
16' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
13' The Auxerre players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
10' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Obed Nkambadio makes a comfortable save.
10' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
7' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
7' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Gideon Mensah (Auxerre). Francois Letexier saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Paris FC.

5' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Paris FC.
3' Great teamplay by Auxerre as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
Auxerre will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Francois Letexier.
